## Component requirements / guardrails

Requirements:
- Claude Behind An Interface: The claude CLI is reached only through claude.Process (stdin lines in, stdout lines out, an exit status); the daemon's tests use claude.Fake fed with lines from tests/fixtures/stream/probe.jsonl, never a real claude.
- Bearer Token On Every Route: Every HTTP route but GET /healthz and the MCP endpoints requires Authorization: Bearer <MORPHD_TOKEN>; /mcp and /mcp/{project} require the same token; /mcp/{project}/session requires that project's current session token. morphd listens on 127.0.0.1 only; TLS and the public name are Caddy's.
- The Session Reports Only Itself: A VPS session can call phase_done, wait_operator and milestone only through its own endpoint /mcp/{project}/session with the token morphd minted for that spawn; the token changes on every spawn, so a past session or another project cannot report.

Guardrails:
- Injected Clock And Ids: No package but cmd/morphd reads the clock or a random source: time comes in as a `now` argument or an injected Now func() time.Time, ids from an injected NewID func() string; time.Now, math/rand and crypto/rand appear only in cmd/morphd. Timers are the daemon's Tick, driven by main's ticker.
- No Network In Tests: Tests never open a listener or dial: HTTP is tested with httptest.NewRecorder and httptest.NewRequest, Telegram and GitHub through an injected Do, the MCP server over in-memory transports; a test writes files only under t.TempDir(); no test runs claude or reaches github.com or api.telegram.org.
- No Shell Outside Runner: os/exec is imported only by package runner (git, morph) and package claude (the claude process); every other package runs commands through runner.Runner and tests script them with runner.Fake.
- Secrets Never Logged: The API token, the session tokens, the GitHub token and the Telegram token never appear in a response body, a log line, a milestone, an error text or the argv of a spawned process; secrets live in files of mode 0600 under the state directory; the git credentials reach git through a credential store file, never through a URL or an argument.

## Function Phase Loop

The state of one project's phase loop and the transitions the PM and the session drive.

Behaviour: Declares in supervisor/loop.go, exactly: `type Action struct { Kind string; Phase string; SessionID string; Resume bool; BudgetUSD float64; Line string; Milestone control.Milestone }`; `type Loop struct { Project string `json:"project"`; Queue queue.Queue `json:"queue"`; State string `json:"state"`; Phase string `json:"phase"`; SessionID string `json:"session_id"`; PhaseStartedAt time.Time `json:"phase_started_at"`; Restarts []time.Time `json:"restarts"`; Stop *control.Stop `json:"stop,omitempty"`; PausedUntil time.Time `json:"paused_until"`; StretchUSD float64 `json:"stretch_usd"`; SessionUSD float64 `json:"session_usd"`; LastEventAt time.Time `json:"last_event_at"`; Nudged bool `json:"nudged"`; Alerted bool `json:"alerted"`; LastExit *control.Exit `json:"last_exit,omitempty"` }` (Restarts: the times the guard restarted the session after an exit, fresh or --resume alike, within the last hour; LastExit: the last exit the guard acted on — both written by Runtime Guard's Exited only); `type Config struct { MaxResumesPerHour int; StallMinutes int; StretchUSD float64; UsageAlertPercent int }`; `var ErrPhaseMismatch = errors.New("phase mismatch")`; `func New(project string, q queue.Queue) *Loop` (State "idle"); `func (l *Loop) Begin(now time.Time) ([]Action, error)`; `func (l *Loop) StartChecked(s gitrules.Start, newID func() string, now time.Time) []Action`; `func (l *Loop) PhaseDone(phase, next string) ([]Action, error)`; `func (l *Loop) EndChecked(e gitrules.End, now time.Time) []Action`; `func (l *Loop) WaitOperator(kind, reason, issueURL string, now time.Time) []Action`; `func (l *Loop) Continue(now time.Time) ([]Action, error)`; `func (l *Loop) Restart(now time.Time) ([]Action, error)`. State is one of "idle", "starting", "running", "paused", "waiting". A post action is Action{Kind: "post", Milestone: {kind, headline, numbers}}. An action carries only the fields its literal names here, every other field zero: start_check and end_check {Kind, Phase}; spawn {Kind, Phase, SessionID, Resume, BudgetUSD}; first_line and write {Kind, Line}; kill {Kind}; post {Kind, Milestone}. Begin (meant for State "idle" or "waiting"): Queue.Start() must succeed — its error is returned as is and nothing changes (a starting, running or paused loop holds a running queue, so a Begin there fails on the queue's state); then Phase = that id, State "starting", Stop nil, Nudged false, Alerted false, SessionUSD 0, Restarts nil, LastExit nil (the PM's plan_load or continue starts the restart count afresh), actions [{Kind "start_check", Phase}]. StartChecked (State "starting"; any other state → nil) never touches Restarts or LastExit (a fresh start after an exit still counts, so a session that dies at once cannot restart without bound): Mode "fresh" → SessionID = newID(), PhaseStartedAt = now, LastEventAt = now, State "running", actions [{Kind "spawn", Phase, SessionID, Resume false, BudgetUSD = the current phase''s Caps.ClaudeUSD}, {Kind "first_line", Line "/morph-orchestrator " + Phase}, {post start "<phase> started" numbers "session <id> · cap $<ClaudeUSD 'f' -1> · <Hours 'f' -1> h"}] (a Reason "pulled to …" appends " · " + Reason to the numbers); Mode "resume" → SessionID kept when non-empty else newID(), State "running", PhaseStartedAt = now, LastEventAt = now, actions [{spawn Resume true …}, {post start "<phase> resumed" numbers "session <id> · " + Reason}] (no first_line); Mode "diverged" or "error" → State "waiting", Stop = {Kind "git", Phase, Reason, At now}, Queue.Stop(Reason), actions [{post stop "<phase> not started: git" numbers Reason}]. PhaseDone: State "running" or "paused" and phase == Phase → actions [{Kind "end_check", Phase}] (nothing else changes); otherwise (nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: phase_done %q while %s %q", ErrPhaseMismatch, phase, State, Phase)). EndChecked (State "running" or "paused"; else nil): e.OK → StretchUSD += SessionUSD; out, err := Queue.Done(Phase, next) where next is the id after the current one in Queue.Phases (or "") — err is impossible here and ignored; actions start with [{Kind "kill"}]; then by out: Next and no Stop → the loop begins that phase at once (the Begin transition: Stop nil, Nudged false, Alerted false, SessionUSD 0): Phase = out.Next, State "starting", SessionID "", actions += [{Kind "start_check", Phase: out.Next}] (Queue.Start() called); Stop "smoke" or "operator" → State "waiting", Stop {Kind out.Stop, Phase: the finished phase, Reason "stop after " + out.Stop, At now}, actions += [{post stop "<phase> done: stop after <kind>" numbers "next <out.Next> · waiting for continue"}]; Stop "end" → State "waiting", Stop {Kind "end", Phase, Reason "plan complete", At now}, actions += [{post end "<phase> done: plan complete" numbers "stretch $<StretchUSD 'f' 4>"}]. e not OK → State "waiting", Stop {Kind "not_pushed", Phase, Reason: e.Problems joined with "; ", At now}, Queue.Stop(Reason), no kill, actions [{post stop "<phase> not pushed" numbers Reason}]. ## Component requirements / guardrails

Requirements:
- Claude Behind An Interface: The claude CLI is reached only through claude.Process (stdin lines in, stdout lines out, an exit status); the daemon's tests use claude.Fake fed with lines from tests/fixtures/stream/probe.jsonl, never a real claude.
- Bearer Token On Every Route: Every HTTP route but GET /healthz and the MCP endpoints requires Authorization: Bearer <MORPHD_TOKEN>; /mcp and /mcp/{project} require the same token; /mcp/{project}/session requires that project's current session token. morphd listens on 127.0.0.1 only; TLS and the public name are Caddy's.
- The Session Reports Only Itself: A VPS session can call phase_done, wait_operator and milestone only through its own endpoint /mcp/{project}/session with the token morphd minted for that spawn; the token changes on every spawn, so a past session or another project cannot report.

Guardrails:
- Injected Clock And Ids: No package but cmd/morphd reads the clock or a random source: time comes in as a `now` argument or an injected Now func() time.Time, ids from an injected NewID func() string; time.Now, math/rand and crypto/rand appear only in cmd/morphd. Timers are the daemon's Tick, driven by main's ticker.
- No Network In Tests: Tests never open a listener or dial: HTTP is tested with httptest.NewRecorder and httptest.NewRequest, Telegram and GitHub through an injected Do, the MCP server over in-memory transports; a test writes files only under t.TempDir(); no test runs claude or reaches github.com or api.telegram.org.
- No Shell Outside Runner: os/exec is imported only by package runner (git, morph) and package claude (the claude process); every other package runs commands through runner.Runner and tests script them with runner.Fake.
- Secrets Never Logged: The API token, the session tokens, the GitHub token and the Telegram token never appear in a response body, a log line, a milestone, an error text or the argv of a spawned process; secrets live in files of mode 0600 under the state directory; the git credentials reach git through a credential store file, never through a URL or an argument.

Write the files: `supervisor/guard.go`.

Go 1.22, the standard library only (go.mod requires nothing; the build runs with GOPROXY=off). gofmt-formatted (gofmt -l prints nothing) and go vet clean.
